title: One worker per responsibility and scope
description:
State the rule once and enforce it with the queue: all wakes of one agent for one serial scope pass through one message group, so they run one at a time, in order. The definition names the scope: `subject` (one Story at a time, many Stories at once), `agent` (the whole agent one at a time, for anything that spends from one budget or posts to one account), or a named key such as the channel account. This replaces `limits.maxConcurrent`, the count of rows in flight, the 120-second grace and the router's deferred retry sweep. The total number of runs at once is the event source's maximum concurrency, set from the model provider's rate limit, a real constraint.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Two wakes in one group never run at the same time.
- A burst for many subjects runs in parallel up to the provider limit.
- `maxConcurrent`, the in-flight count and the deferred sweep are deleted.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- one-worker.feature: two changes to one Story run in order; changes to two Stories run together; an agent with scope `agent` runs one at a time across all subjects; a slow run delays only its own group.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Event source mapping maximum concurrency as a template parameter.

**Part of:** Inbox: change feeds, the wake queue and one worker. Slice code B4 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.

comments.author: home
comments.text: B4 part 1 shipped in PR #1711: a wake's message group is now the agent plus its serial scope from the definition's serialBy, carried in trigger.serialBy: subject (default for wakes no definition governs), agent (one scope for the whole agent; the announce agent now runs one at a time across all Stories), or key:<name> with the value in trigger.serialKey (a missing value or an unknown scope is not a wake). The wake records its scope. Spec: features_backend/one-worker.feature; unit tests in agent_wakes_test.py. Still open on this ticket: delete limits.maxConcurrent, the in-flight count, the 120-second grace and the router's deferred sweep (automation_gate.py, monitoring_router.py, automations.py), and the event source mapping's maximum concurrency as a template parameter (needs the live deploy path, not built here).
